exposure: Gestational age at birth (22(+1) to 33(+6) weeks vs. late preterm)
cohort: 26,022 singleton live births weighing >500g and delivered at >22(+1) weeks of gestation between January 2015 and December 2019 at a tertiary university hospital in Malaysia
finding: The incidence of preterm birth showed an inconsistent trend from 2015 to 2019 in a tertiary university hospital in Malaysia, with a far higher prevalence compared to national data.
mod_finding: The risk of preterm babies being admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) or the ward compared to the risk of neonatal mortality increases for babies delivered via caesarean
